objective: Plan clean distinct country-radio and NTS entry points, archived NTS show search/playback, and easy known prompts/help plus same-browser cross-thread controls, reusing the owner Omarchy NTS reference where suitable.

reports.complexity: High: this combines entry-point/tool semantics, UI accessibility and command discoverability, an undocumented changing API, untrusted metadata/media URLs, external media resolution, playback-mode state, CSP/network policy, autoplay gesture rules, and cross-thread browser coordination.
evidence: Current server exposes open_radio with one known Radio Paradise station and find_stations_by_country with a country resource; current country resource includes NTS 1/2 as a tab, so there is no dedicated NTS app entry point or archive-search tool yet.

Current NTS direct live URLs are stream-relay-geo.ntslive.net/stream and /stream2 with client=direct; current policy lists the relay and two redirect origins observed on 2026-11-12. This is existing tested live-channel policy, not evidence for archive media origins.

PlaybackCoordinator.pauseRemote() sends a bounded pause request to a reported active peer, waits up to 1800 ms for acknowledgement, and reports failure when no peer is available. Coordination is via Web Locks and BroadcastChannel; these are browser-context capabilities and provide no cross-device identity or guarantee.

The reference describes NTS archive API as undocumented, derived from nts.live player calls. It requires version=2 for useful /search results, clamps query to 120 characters and page size to 1..40, and parses show/episode results from /api/v2/search.

Bounded live NTS response check on 2026-11-13: GET https://www.nts.live/api/v2/search?q=Floating%20Points&version=2&offset=0&limit=3&types%5B%5D=show returned HTTP JSON with result count 13 and three show metadata rows. A separate limit=6 episode query returned count 639 and six episode metadata rows; sampled audio_sources pointed to soundcloud.com. No complete inventory was requested or retained.
Reference NtsApi.js accepts episode audio source pages only on HTTPS SoundCloud/Mixcloud hosts and warns against shipping NTS's embedded Basic credential for /resolve-stream.

Reference README says NTS does not host archive audio: episode sources are SoundCloud or Mixcloud; local playback relies on mpv yt-dlp hook. Resolver.qml uses yt-dlp to select progressive HTTP(S) and describes HLS/DASH as unsuitable for its Chromecast direct-media path. Dial's browser app cannot run this local subprocess.
The reference preserves archive seek/resume position but treats live resume as rejoining the current relay; carrying these semantics to browser media needs an explicit Spec and host verification.

Public NTS episode page evidence and NTS Supporter copy expose archive episodes and state that tracklist timestamps are a supporter feature; do not expose timestamps as generally available. Sources: https://www.nts.live/shows/selassie-tbc/episodes/selassie-tbc-8th-may-2020 and https://www.nts.live/supporters.

Browser-host playback evidence remains distinct from metadata response: the bounded API response proves metadata discovery only. No browser media request, redirect/CSP outcome, audible playback, or archive seek/pause behavior was tested in ChatGPT host.

findings.evidence: Independent controller harness produced resolver count 1 after first Play, media error, and Retry. fail() only calls stop(); it does not invalidate candidate/destroy HLS.
findings.finding: Archive failures retain archiveUrl and hls. Pressing Play to retry skips resolution whenever expires is absent or more than 60 seconds away, and reuses an existing failed HLS instance. A revoked URL/network failure therefore cannot obtain the fresh URL promised by the specification. The candidate is also cached indefinitely absent expires; no resolved-at five-minute limit exists.
findings.requested_change: Distinguish resumable pause from failure; on Retry invalidate failed candidate and rebuild HLS, preserving selected episode and safe resume position. Enforce the maximum candidate age and test retries before signature expiry and without expires.

findings.evidence: The sole Hls.Events.ERROR handler is inside the startup Promise and only invokes reject; MANIFEST_PARSED resolves the same promise.
findings.finding: Fatal hls.js errors after MANIFEST_PARSED only reject the already-resolved manifest promise. They never call fail(), release ownership, or update status. HLS segment/network failures need not emit HTMLMediaElement error, so the player can remain Playing/Buffering indefinitely while holding ownership.
findings.requested_change: Keep an attempt/source/instance-scoped fatal-error handler throughout playback that transitions to a clean retryable error, releases ownership and invalidates failed media; ignore stale-instance events. Test fatal errors both before and after manifest parsing.

findings.evidence: Independent delivered-script reproduction: late country response after open NTS yielded ntsHidden=true/title Choose a station; late old search after new nts-search launch rendered Old search.
findings.finding: New NTS/nts-search/pause-control launches return before invalidating pending country/archive requests. An old country picker response can clear the new NTS selection, stop playback and switch views; an old in-app archive search can replace newer chat-requested results while leaving the new query displayed.

findings.requested_change: Use a launch/action generation to invalidate superseded country/search/show requests and cancel pending automatic pause work when a newer view takes over. Restore busy controls on invalidation. Cover transitions across launch modes, not only same-kind request races.

findings.evidence: Only pauseLocal saves currentTime at line 81; coordinator.onStop bypasses it. The loadedmetadata handler is registered after source attachment/manifest await and has no immediate-ready path.
findings.finding: Remote Pause calls stop() and clearSource() without saving archive currentTime. clearSource removes src and loads the element, resetting position; next Play uses the old resumeTime (often zero). Also the resume loadedmetadata listener is installed after awaiting HLS MANIFEST_PARSED, so metadata may already have arrived and restoration can be missed.
findings.requested_change: Preserve position on remote pause and ownership stop for the selected archive; restore position using a guarded media-readiness routine that handles metadata already available and ignores stale source/attempt callbacks. Add remote pause/resume and expired-candidate HLS restoration tests.

findings.evidence: Independent controller harness exposed seekable start=10/end=90 with duration=100; requesting zero assigned currentTime=0.
findings.finding: Seek and resume clamp to 0..duration, not the actual seekable TimeRanges. Finite duration plus any range does not mean the full duration is seekable, so the UI permits unavailable positions and can seek into gaps.
findings.requested_change: Derive enabled range(s) from seekable, clamp user seek and restored position to a valid range, and test offset/disjoint ranges.

findings.evidence: Source inspection: after await claimIfIdle, lines 142-145 unconditionally set wanted=false/show paused, before the later generic stale-attempt guard at line 155. Source change can occur during that await.
findings.finding: The external Media Play failure and invalid-token branches mutate wanted/status (and can release the coordinator) without first checking currentAttempt against attempt. A delayed claimIfIdle result from a canceled source can overwrite a newly selected/playing source; the normal acquire failure branch already has an epoch check but the external branch lacks it.
findings.requested_change: Check attempt/abort/source validity immediately after either ownership await before any global state mutation or lock release; associate releases with the acquired epoch. Test delayed external claim completion after selecting/playing another source.

Independently confirmed ordinary direct resume preserves 72 seconds, retained HLS fatal error after resume becomes error, destroys the instance and releases ownership, and stale instances cannot fail a replacement. Reviewed earlier fixes for fresh resolution on Retry/five-minute age, remote pause position, ready-media restoration, seekable ranges, stale launch responses and stale OS claims. Their regression coverage passes. Pause remount protection remains bounded sessionStorage IDs plus issuedAt freshness and fail-closed automatic behavior.
reports.requirements: Read approved PRODUCT.md and TECH.md and confirmed their SHA-256 hashes match the dispatch approval. Reviewed prior actual Review reports and current source. Both attempt-2 followups are resolved. Dedicated country/NTS views, Help, explicit Play gesture, historical aliases and bounded archive policy remain intact. ACCEPT is code-review acceptance for independent Verify, not proof of ChatGPT audible archive playback or Android support.
reports.security: Revision changes only controller source and regression tests; it does not broaden origin/CSP policy or signed-URL exposure. Source inspection confirms app-only resolver _meta, exact SoundCloud media origin, fixed NTS endpoint/alias validation, subprocess argv and timeout/output bounds remain. Five-minute candidate reuse and failure invalidation remain enforced. Existing first-playlist validation does not establish host handling of all redirects/nested playlists; actual host CSP/CORS remains a required independent verification boundary. No signed URL values exposed in this review.
tests: Independently ran npm test against the exact candidate: build succeeded; 56/56 tests passed, including protocol, delivered bundle, lifecycle, native/direct ordinary resume, stale HLS instance, stale claim and pause remount checks.

Independently reran saved prior reviewer reproduction node --test /tmp/dial012-review-revision-lifecycle.mjs: 7/7 passed. Fatal-after-resume output: state=error, destroyed=true, lockHeld=false. Direct resume position=72.
Read the current controller, request invalidation and pause-remount implementation and test cases; inspected current shared-view/help HTML and server archive/CSP/meta boundaries.

git diff --check passed; git diff c073716 -- src public package.json package-lock.json test was empty. HEAD was the dispatched full commit. Only temporary report and ignored generated build outputs were written by this Review.

No new browser/network/audio or phone verification performed. Historical Nov17 Chromium evidence is not a fresh host/audio claim. Actual ChatGPT _meta forwarding, MSE/CSP, audible archives, prompt routing, cross-thread scope and Android/Bluetooth remain unverified.

criteria.criterion: Design separate, directly invokable country-radio and NTS experiences with clear prompts and accessible in-app help while preserving clean minimal layouts and shared playback ownership.
criteria.evidence: The candidate registers open_country_radio, open_nts_radio, search_nts_archive and pause_dial. Protocol tests assert distinct launch modes and app-only tool visibility; UI bundle tests and player/coordinator tests pass. Help examples and labels are present in the shared renderer. npm test: 56 passed, 0 failed. This verifies implementation and local protocol behavior, not observed model routing in the ChatGPT host.
criteria.method: Inspected approved PRODUCT/TECH and current tool registrations, shared view/player source and MCP server protocol tests; ran npm test.

criteria.criterion: Investigate NTS archived-show keyword search and stream resolution using the owner Omarchy NTS reference and current primary sources; distinguish supported results, metadata, playback formats, expiring URLs and failure modes.
criteria.evidence: Fresh search returned 12 normalized results including show and episode rows. One returned Floating Points episode resolved to HLS AAC candidate on the single approved SoundCloud media origin; evidence stores origin, path, query key names, and expiry presence only. Source/tests enforce NTS alias/path validation, exact media origin/path, expiry checks and playlist origin validation. See evidence/run-0fec9b5003c6/fresh-nts-check.json. This establishes one metadata/resolution path, not host playback.
criteria.method: Ran one bounded live search and selected episode resolution through the candidate's searchArchive/resolveEpisode methods; inspected current source policy and ran archive tests.

criteria.criterion: Define discoverable prompts and concrete tool routing for opening, searching, playing and pausing; state explicit browser gesture requirements and the supported cross-thread control scope without implying cross-device identity.
criteria.evidence: The four model-visible tools and app-only archive tools are registered and protocol-tested. Help contains natural-language examples and asks the user to press Play in-app. Playback and pause-control use the shared coordinator; code/tests keep cross-thread claims bounded to shared browser context and report acknowledgement states. Local fixture's explicit Play/Pause/Resume actions succeeded. Actual model routing and same-browser cross-thread behavior inside ChatGPT remain unobserved and are covered as blocked under criterion 5.
criteria.method: Inspected tool descriptions, UI Help copy and coordinator implementation; ran MCP server protocol and lifecycle suite; executed local Chromium fixture with explicit mouse gestures.

criteria.criterion: Produce a bounded product and technical proposal with exact trust/network policy, playback state, archive seek/resume semantics, acceptance checks and rollback; require exact owner approval before production changes.
criteria.evidence: PRODUCT.md and TECH.md match approved SHA-256 values in dispatch packet. Candidate HEAD is c073716626a35d3db189bb814373afaa00864dd0; the implementation changes and tests are committed there. The specs define exact origins, bounded resolver/search, playback lifecycle, acceptance and rollback.
criteria.method: Verified approved spec hashes from dispatch against files and reviewed candidate and source policies; confirmed HEAD is exact dispatched commit.

criteria.criterion: Independent Review and Verify must assess any implemented candidate with real protocol/browser and host evidence, preserving missing evidence honestly.
criteria.evidence: Independent protocol/browser evidence passes: local Chromium with explicit gesture received manifest/media responses 200 on the approved origin, MSE/HLS supported, time advanced, pause/resume/seek succeeded with no error. Saved 2026-11-17 fixture script was rerun on 2026-11-23; redacted output is evidence/run-0fec9b5003c6/local-chromium.json. No authenticated ChatGPT MCP App browser/host trace was available, so actual _meta forwarding, CSP/blob admission in ChatGPT, audible archive playback, prompt routing, and same-browser cross-thread control remain BLOCKED. Owner Android/ChatGPT app session was unavailable; foreground/background/lock-screen, notification, Bluetooth keys/output and idle-only media-key Play remain BLOCKED. These outcomes are not inferred from desktop tests.
criteria.method: Ran npm test (56/56), saved reviewer reproduction (7/7), fresh bounded NTS lookup/resolution and reran the saved local Chromium HLS fixture; checked available host access and prior reports.
